page.overview:
Who is Eyegore?

In , can be found in the and the , and later in . They stand still until they are approached, when they open their eye and charge at for a brief moment. Only when their eye is open are they vulnerable to attacks. are split into two groups; and . can be defeated with just the , but they are durable and require many hits to defeat. An or a thrown straight in the eye defeats them instantly. are completely immune to all attacks even when their eye is open, except to . Two will defeat .

Decorative statues also appear in various dungeons in both the and , and one in particular is key to solving a specific puzzle. Some of them also hold .

In , are hulking monsters with slender bodies and large heads, which consist solely of their eye. Only two of them appear in the . They stand dormant until approached. Once awake, they will creep forward and fire beams at from their single yellow eye. They will also slam the ground with their fists to send rocks flying at him. When has been warded off, they will quickly retreat to their point of origin and become dormant again. can be stunned by aiming the or at their eye, thus leaving them open to further attack. They can only be damaged when their eye is yellow.

In , appear as stone statue-like monsters with horns and a prominent single eye. Initially, they are dormant, but awaken and hop after when approached. They can appear in any stage, including the and in .
